Name: HXNS Automate Fix for Cornucopia's Growable Forage
Author: Hexnessie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Do you love Automate and Custom  Bush mods, but can't get it to work properly with Cornucopia? This mod is for you!

There are two sets of mechanics:

[list=1]
[*]The number of berries you get is based on your Foraging level, similar to the regular salmonberry and blueberry bushes. Food DOES NOT affect the number of berries from custom bushes, i.e. the maximum you can get (at Foraging 10) is 3.  
If you chose the Gatherer profession, you have a chance to get a double drop - up to 6 berries at Foraging 10. [/*]
[*]The quality of berries is always 0 - basic quality. If you chose the Botanist profession, the quality changes to Iridium.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Use a mod manager or unzip the archive into your game's Mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod was written with Automate and Custom Bush in mind, and drop definitions include items from Cornucopia (basic and More Crops, Herbs pack) and Cornucopia Growable Forage.[/color][/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=3][b][u]NO AI WAS USED IN THE CREATION OF THIS MOD[/u][/b][/size][/color]
